packageRules.description: The p2panda crates are git deps pinned to one shared upstream rev and must move together; per-crate PRs break the pkgs/id Nix build (#643).

The opencode and openchamber flake inputs are owned by the flake-inputs-update GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/flake-inputs-update.yml), which bumps, validates, and merges them daily. Renovate must not update them.
